description: This file defines the LogFragment class, a subclass of Fragment used in Android development. It manages a UI component consisting of a LogView within a ScrollView, facilitating the display of log data received via the LogNode interface. The class handles the creation and configuration of views, including setting padding, typeface, and layout parameters. It also sets up a TextWatcher to auto-scroll the log when new text is added.

classes.name: LogFragment
classes.description: A Fragment subclass that contains a LogView for displaying log data, managing view initialization, styling, and auto-scrolling behavior.

methods.name: inflateViews
methods.description: Creates and configures the ScrollView and LogView, setting layout parameters, styling, and padding, then returns the root view.

methods.name: onCreateView
methods.description: Lifecycle method that inflates the views, sets up a TextWatcher to auto-scroll on text changes, and returns the root view.

methods.name: getLogView
methods.description: Accessor method that returns the LogView instance managed by this fragment.
